address: 18 Ash Street Bowness on Windermere Cumbria,LA23 3EB
bio: BAHA promises the perfect place to relax and indulge in a classic Afternoon Tea with a modern flair.  BAHA's Luxury Lake District Afternoon Tea menu consists of a wonderful selection of indulgent treats, warm scones, and sumptuous sandwiches; along with a glass each of rosé prosecco and the choice to upgrade to abottle of Laurent-Perrier Cuveé Rosé for £99.  Set in a large, stunning venue with unbelievable decor, BAHA is the perfect place to for large groups to get together forAfternoon Tea, whether it’s for a birthday, a hen party or simply because you love to treat yourself. Furry friends & well-behaved owners are also welcome.  A gluten free option is also available for a supplement of £5.
